message.content: The airspace information I keep is governed by the **EU drone operation rules (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947)** and the **EU U-space rules (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664)**. These rules define how zones are designated, how closures are announced, and how flight information must be shared and managed. I don’t enforce compliance or provide guarantees—just track the shared airspace data as it’s given by authorities and used by customers.
